Header-only probing, EXIF orientation, geometry ops and hostile-input guards. kotlin-stdlib only; 22 targets across Android, JVM, Apple, Linux, Windows, androidNative, JS and Wasm.

items.title: io.github.yuroyami:kiteimage-compose-js 0.1.0 发布, Compose Multiplatform binding for KiteImage: the KiteImage() composable, which auto-detects animated versus static input and plays GIF, APNG and animated lossless WebP with correct delays, disposal and loop count, plus KiteBitmap-to-ImageBitmap conversion. Builds for the seven Compose Multiplatform targets, not the full KiteImage core set.
